cohort: The study included 113 mothers of premature infants who had been discharged from the hospital at least 1 month prior and applied to a pediatric outpatient clinic.
finding: Mother-infant contact barriers were found to increase postpartum depression, which in turn decreased maternal attachment, with postpartum depression playing a mediating role in this relationship.
cross-section timing: Data was collected between April and November 2022 from mothers whose premature babies had been discharged at least 1 month prior.
